approach: Actual original terrain GLB BVH after official world normalization; closed undercut/ledge/shoulder rock carrier with physical .045m bevel. Rotated real scan cap perimeter buried .045m inside that body. No floating/open photogrammetry slices.
backRidge: Low ridge behind Z=-9.15, actual cap generally <=local ground+.6m; no elevated backdrop next to pine crown.
color: Exact parent PBR slate RGBToBW(diff)*(.62,.77,.80); no yellow/gold moss. Original images kept unchanged; deterministic baked material operation in new *_slate/moss_albedo files.
unchanged: Original terrain source, nav, heights, road, bridges, actor, game code untouched. Foreground bodies start Z=1.53, outside safeGround; low rear ridge stays Z<=-9.15.
